doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Prerequisites: Python 3.12+, rustybt development environment. Setup includes pip install with validation extras and Backtrader installation.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: CLI commands: rustybt-validate session create, rustybt-validate run, rustybt-validate report. Click-based command-line tool.

doc.title: PRD
doc.snippet: Minimum 3-4 strategies validated, including Simple Moving Average Crossover as first strategy.

constraints.constraint: Installation must include both rustybt and Backtrader in compatible environment
Subprocess isolation pattern: frameworks can be in same env but executable separately
CLI interface: rustybt-validate session create, rustybt-validate run, rustybt-validate report
Target time: complete guide executable in <15 minutes
All commands must be copy-pasteable and work on first try

tests.standards: All commands must be copy-pasteable and work on first try. Expected output must exactly match actual output. Time requirement: complete guide executable in <15 minutes.
